The partial autocorrelation function (PACF) also does not cut off after p lags; instead, it tails off similarly to the ACF. Therefore, neither the ACF nor the PACF is zero after a specific number of lags for an ARMA(p,q) model with both p and q greater than zero. The correct description is that both decline geometrically.
